item.title: Trump Pulls FDA Nominee, Senate Blocks NSF Pick After
item.description: In a rapid political shakeup, President Trump withdrew his FDA nominee Heidi Overton and the Senate halted a vote on his NSF pick, raising questions about agency leadership and vaccine policy. This move underscores the tension between executive appointments and Senate oversight, and it highlights the contentious debate over vaccine safety and misinformation.

item.title: New York Measles Death Highlights Vaccine Crisis in US
item.description: First measles death in New York in 30+ years underscores a national surge, with seven U.S. fatalities this year amid declining vaccination rates.
